title: Some people are busy for God.
paragraphs: Some people are busy for God.

Martha was serving.
Mary was sitting.
But Jesus said Mary chose what was better.
The danger isn't doing too little.
The danger is doing so much that you stop listening.
And when prayer disappears, ministry slowly becomes self-powered instead of Spirit-led.

Question:
Can someone serve God… while neglecting God?
Before scrolling… take 10 quiet seconds with God today.
“BUSY” or “PRESENCE” — which side do you feel today?
